review_locator: PMCID:PMC6474201, Sensing of physiological regulators by innate lymphoid cells; PMCID:PMC6221181, Neuroendocrine regulation of innate lymphoid cells
primary_title: Neuronal regulation of type 2 innate lymphoid cells via neuromedin U
decision_basis: The reviews cite the primary study showing NMU activates NMUR1-positive ILC2s and induces type-2 cytokine production, including IL-5 protein.
limitations_preserved: NMU stimulation increased measured IL-5 protein output from sorted mouse intestinal ILC2s through an NMUR1-dependent context; preserve the peptide, receptor, cell type and protein assay boundaries.
